concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level named 'user' in the ordered hierarchy of authority levels

concepts.name: model_spec_user_section
concepts.gloss: a section of the Model Spec document that is marked as a 'user' section

concepts.name: user_message
concepts.gloss: a message sent by the user in the conversation

concepts.name: assigned_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level assigned to the given Model Spec section or user message

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ordered list of authority levels from highest to lowest: root, system, developer, user, guideline, no authority

ontology.gloss: a Model Spec 'user' section is assigned the user authority level
a user message is assigned the user authority level
